description: Whether a token's sign-in meets a requirement: every ceremony in amr among the token's amr, and the token's auth_time at most maxAge seconds before now and at most 60 seconds after it. A fact the token does not state clearly (absent, empty, repeated, a method outside bip322, passkey, email, google, github, or an auth_time that is not a whole number of seconds) meets nothing; an empty requirement is met by every token. Read by auth-core (src/__tests__/sign-in-rule.test.ts); sdk-py is held to the same file. Every requirement in refused_requirements is refused by the checker as a mistake in the call, never read as no requirement.
